cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Move It for Me
cards.instruction: Get someone to rearrange an ordinary commitment as proof that your relationship takes priority.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Move your haircut so we can have lunch. I taught you to leave space for the people who matter.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've had that appointment for weeks.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good, you've learned to plan. Now learn when to change one. I'd like to come before a trim just once.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They charge twenty pounds if I move it today.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll pay. Tell them you're moving it to see me, then put lunch in that slot. Let's see you use the confidence I spent years teaching you.

reason: Make A grade planning as incomplete without relational flexibility and pay the actual cost while requiring explicit displacement for its sake.
